row.team_price_text: Usage-priced: on-demand $6.25/TiB (first 1 TiB/month free) or editions from $0.04/slot-hour
row.sso_plan: All (via Cloud Identity Free or Workforce Identity Federation)
row.evidence: BigQuery access is controlled with "Identity and Access Management (IAM) predefined roles"; Google's guides provision users into Cloud Identity from Entra ID and Okta through IdP-built connectors, and Workforce Identity Federation is "sync-less", so no SCIM endpoint exists for BigQuery.
row.notes: New row. BigQuery is a Google Cloud service with usage-based pricing (no seats): on-demand $6.25 per TiB after the free first TiB each month, or capacity editions (Standard $0.04, Enterprise $0.06 per slot-hour pay-as-you-go, US list). There are no BigQuery user accounts: people are Google identities (Cloud Identity Free/Premium or Workspace) or Workforce Identity Federation principals, granted IAM roles. IdPs (Okta's Google Workspace app, Microsoft's Google Cloud/G Suite Connector) provision Cloud Identity through Google's Directory API, so api_provisioning is true and idp is api_connector, scored as for google-workspace. Third-party IdP SSO is in Cloud Identity Free.

plans.name: On-demand
plans.price_text: $6.25 per TiB queried; first 1 TiB per month free
plans.notes: Usage-priced; no per-user fee. SSO is via Cloud Identity (Free edition supports third-party IdP SSO) or Workforce Identity Federation.

plans.name: Enterprise Plus edition
plans.price_text: Slot-hour pricing on the pricing page (region-dependent)

limitations.text: BigQuery has no user directory of its own: access is granted with IAM roles to Google identities (Cloud Identity / Google Workspace accounts and groups) or to Workforce Identity Federation principals.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint into BigQuery or Cloud Identity is documented; Google's guides provision Cloud Identity from Entra and Okta through IdP-built connectors, and Workforce Identity Federation is described as sync-less.

capabilities.notes: User lifecycle is Cloud Identity's Admin SDK Directory API; BigQuery access is IAM policy on projects, datasets and tables.

endpoints.purpose: List users (Cloud Identity / Workspace Directory API)
Update a dataset, including its access[] list (who can access the data)
Set the IAM policy on a table

rate_limits.text: BigQuery API: up to 100 requests per second per user per method; separate IAM policy quotas apply.

okta.notes: Via Okta's Google Workspace app, which provisions Cloud Identity / Workspace (not BigQuery itself). OIN search for 'bigquery' returns no BigQuery app.

entra.notes: Via the Google Cloud/G Suite Connector by Microsoft gallery app, which provisions Cloud Identity / Workspace.

google.notes: Google Workspace users are native Google identities; no catalogue app needed.

fallbacks.other_sync: Identities come from Cloud Identity / Google Workspace (IdP connectors, Google Cloud Directory Sync) or Workforce Identity Federation (sync-less SSO from an external IdP); BigQuery access via IAM roles.
